summary: A teenager's first job is likely to end within a year, while older workers have years of tenure.
realLife: The Bureau of Labor Statistics reported about 74 percent of workers aged 16 to 19 had a year or less with their employer, compared with about 9 percent of workers 55 to 64.
sources: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Employee Tenure news release: https://www.bls.gov/news.release/tenure.nr0.htm
inGame: job record start dates; job-ended event rates by age.
